# Walk the interview

The 7 stages, in the browser. Your answers stay in this browser (nothing is sent anywhere); the route on the right is picked by the rules as you answer, with the rule named; the last stage writes your record as markdown to copy or save. For the conversation the page cannot have, take the record to [a model with the prompt](prompt.md).

The component is `assets/components/sg-finder/`, three files in the shape [coding.sgit.ai](https://coding.sgit.ai/javascript/index.html) documents, on a base component kept in this repository; the rules it applies are [`finder-rules.js`](finder-rules.js), the same module the release test runs. Answers are kept under `startups.finder.v1` in this browser's storage until you clear them.
